initial_decision.brief_rationale: The checks verify arithmetic, but do not establish causal identification. Please retrieve R296-3 to determine whether the design justifies interpreting the standardized difference as the average causal risk difference.

final_decision.brief_rationale: R296-3 establishes conditional exchangeability, consistency, no interference, and positivity, identifying the effect by standardization over Z. Stratum risk differences are 0.4−0.6=−0.2 and 0.8−0.6=0.2. Population weighting gives (250/350)(−0.2)+(100/350)(0.2)=−0.08571428571428572.
